description: Offline Capture the Case on Complex: one human plus three simulants, started through the direct debug match path and ended by a 150 second time limit. Proves the match-start contract for an objective scenario: the launch seed derives the runtime mode from the scenario catalog id, the team-only mode turns Teams on and seats the bots on two teams, mpStartMatch initializes the scenario, the stage loads, the player spawns, the time limit ends the match, and the result witness lists every participant and both teams. It does not yet assert an objective scoring event; that needs the per-scenario objective witness. B-1126: on an arena without intro CASE and CASERESPAWN pads (every extracted arena today), each team in play gets a base on a walkable pad as far as possible from the other bases and up to six respawn pads nearest its base; the smoke asserts that every team's case is on a pad in a room with respawn pads, which also holds once the arenas carry their own pads. Local scoring (T-NETWORKING-011): a 150 second match gives the simulants time to score, and the result must show at least one nonzero score; MATCH.POINTS lines show who scored and when.

input_sequence.comment: Boot, seed the Combat Simulator config for this scenario, and fire the direct debug match start.
Bounded exit after stage load, a 150 second match and the end screen.

required_lines: MATCH\.SCENARIO\.RULES: reason=launch-mp-room id='base:capture_the_case' mode=5 team_based=1 teams_enabled_here=1
PLAYER\.INIT\.PREFLIGHT match=ok players=1 bots=3 stage='base:arena_mp_complex' scenario='base:capture_the_case'
CTC: team [0-3] case on base [0-3] pad=[0-9]+ room=[1-9][0-9]* respawnpads=[1-6] prop=ok
forbidden_patterns: CTC: team [0-9] case on base [0-9] pad=-?[0-9]+ room=(0|-1)
CTC: team [0-9] case on base [0-9] pad=-?[0-9]+ room=-?[0-9]+ respawnpads=[0-9]+ prop=none

required_counts.pattern: CTC: team [0-3] case on base [0-3] pad=[0-9]+ room=[1-9][0-9]* respawnpads=[1-6] prop=ok
SPAWN\.ORCH: team [0-9] starts at its base
